coverage.statement: 46 notes reviewed across 3 competitors; 4 libraries could not be fully verified.

libraries.note: The official LC and LC/MS Application Finder data inventory was reviewed in full and filtered to the exact horizon and allowed content types.
The official resource page did not expose an enumerable, dated LC/LC-MS inventory. Only notes whose PDF title, type, date code, instruments and official URL were confirmed are included.
The index was reachable and reported 939 technical notes, but result cards and reviewed note pages did not print a publication date. No date was inferred from crawl time or references.

All 100 records in the official LCMS-TQ RX merged-download inventory were reviewed through the vendor's JSON inventory endpoint; 27 dated application notes qualified in the exact horizon. Additional term-varied checks covered PFAS, peptide/biopharma, intact-protein and food applications, but other Shimadzu LC/LC-MS product-family libraries were not exhaustively enumerated. Twenty-six PDFs use Shimadzu's exact 'Application News' label rather than the index facet's 'Application Note' label.

The accessible PerkinElmer application search was GC-oriented and did not expose an LC/LC-MS inventory or total; no qualifying Revvity instrument-workflow note with a printed in-window date was verified.

secondPassUrlCheck.note: The 27 Shimadzu and two Thermo Fisher PDF URLs returned PDF content on both checks. Agilent's 17 exact PDF URLs returned HTTP 403 to the automated second-pass client; each URL and its title, date, type and named system were reconfirmed twice in the official Agilent Application Finder inventory, and none redirected to a library or search-results page. This access-control limitation is reported rather than treated as a successful direct PDF re-open.

termVariedBackstop.handling: Only official vendor records were considered. Search-result crawl dates were not treated as publication dates; candidates without a date printed on the official record or document were excluded.

selfAudit.fieldCheck: Every included row was checked against an official vendor library record or official PDF for title, printed date or printed date code, named system, note type and vendor identity.

mostRepeatedTheme.tieBreakRule: Highest verified note count; alphabetical theme name would break a tie.

mostActiveNotePublisher.boundary: Ranking is computed only from the 46 verified notes and is not a complete cross-vendor publication-volume comparison because four libraries are incomplete.
